data.description:
## What
Create plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh — a bash helper that examines a git diff and identifies applicable cleanup recipes from the registry.

## Why
TDD GREEN phase: implement the detection script to make RED tests from be56-3751 pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Script exists at plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh and is executable
- Reads staged diff via git diff --cached (or accepts --diff-file=<path> for test injection)
- For each file in the diff, extracts file extension and maps to applicable cleanup recipes:
  - .py → check normalize-imports (python) recipe in registry
  - .ts / .tsx → check normalize-imports (typescript) recipe
  - .rb → check normalize-imports (ruby) recipe
- Only outputs recipes that exist in the registry (no phantom recipes)
- --format=json flag: outputs JSON array [{"name": "normalize-imports", "language": "python"}]
- No diff / no applicable recipe types: exits 0 with no output
- RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH env var overrides registry path (required for test isolation)
- All tests in test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh pass

## File Impact
- CREATE: plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh

## Testing Mode
GREEN — make failing tests pass

## Dependencies
- be56-3751 (RED tests must exist first)
data.title: GREEN: Implement detect-cleanup-recipes.sh
